correctness.rationale: From the inspected actual RESULT.md and original verify.py, the resolvent of LJ gives T_c(t)=[[ (1-2it)/(1+it), it/(1+it) ],[1,0]] and T_h(t,u)=[[ (1-i(t+u))/(1+it), iu/(1+it) ],[1,0]]. Rebuilt the two monodromies independently in symbolic algebra; both determinants equal -ab/[(1+ia)(1+ib)], of modulus strictly less than 1. Direct Schur–Cohn evaluation factors the respective strict-stability gaps as 8ab(1-4ab)(1+2(a+b)^2)/[(1+a²)²(1+b²)²] and 4(1-(a+b)²)((a+b)^4+a²+b²)/[(1+a²)²(1+b²)²]. Reconstructed det(I+M)=2(1-4ab)/D or 2(1-(a+b)²)/D; the threshold root is -1 and other root strictly inside disk. Beyond the boundary there is exactly one expanding multiplier. Equal-history data yield z_1/z_0=(1-ia)/(1+ia) of modulus 1 and cannot lie in the decaying one-dimensional monodromy eigenspace. Independent spectral samples confirm the factors, without replacing proof. Quantifiers limited to positive a,b, L>0 and exactly two-period prescribed steps on A=B=LJ.
